First, 46 weeks and 1 day = 46 × 7 + 1 = 323 days.  
2001-07-05 minus 323 days:  
2001 is not a leap year, so go back:  
From 2001-07-05 back 5 days → 2001-06-30.  
Back 30 more days (June) → 2001-05-31.  
Remaining days: 323 − 5 − 30 = 288 days earlier from 2001-05-31.  
Work backwards month by month:  
April 30 days → 2001-05-01, March 31 days, February 28 days (2001 not leap), January 31 days, December 31 days, November 30 days, October 31 days, September 30 days, August 31 days, July 31 days.  
Sum from May 1 back:  
April 30, March 31, Feb 28, Jan 31, Dec 31, Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, July 31.  
Total = 30+31+28+31+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 304 days back to 2000-07-31 from 2001-05-01.  
We need 288 days back from 2001-05-31:  
From 2001-05-31 back 304 days to 2000-07-31 is too far (we overshoot). Let’s compute directly:  

Better: 2001-07-05 minus 323 days.  
2001-07-05 → 2000-07-05 is 366 days earlier (2000 is leap year).  
We need 323 days earlier, so 2000-07-05 plus (366 − 323) = 43 days forward from 2000-07-05.  
July 5 + 43 days: July has 26 days left (31-5=26) → 2000-07-31.  
Remaining 43 − 26 = 17 days into August → 2000-08-17.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2000-08-17
